what_this_is: Paths and content patterns that must never appear in a public tree (this repository, a published dataset, a package). Read by scripts/policy/check_no_protected.py. Policy: docs/policy/OPEN-AND-PROTECTED.md.

reach_calibration.why: reach tables joined into the probe plan, and any tuned routing/reach weights

private_negative_controls.why: generators of private negative controls (a published generator lets a target train against it)

priority_heuristics.why: what we probe first and why, beyond the published plan rule

keys_and_secrets.why: witness / signing private keys and credentials

public_by_decision.plan-top20.json: the plan CONFIG (fraction, counts, ranking rule) was published on 2026-09-25 in the signed mcp-remote-census record and the public HF dataset csoai/mcp-remote-census; it is open by that act and is deliberately not listed above
public_by_decision.scripts/census/reach.py: the ranking CODE is open (Apache-2.0 intent); only its calibrated inputs are protected
